title: Hafele and Keating flew atomic clocks in 1971
summary: A 1972 Science paper reports relativistic time shifts of atomic clocks flown around the world.
body: J. C. Hafele and Richard E. Keating reported in Science in 1972 that atomic clocks flown around the world gained or lost time in the pattern predicted when both special-relativistic motion and gravitational potential are taken into account. The paper is a clock-comparison experiment, not a derivation of relativity. It is one of the direct time-dilation tests. It does not by itself license slogans about "twelve decimal places."
